# OpenGeo Cambodia API

> Free, keyless, read-only REST API for Cambodia's administrative geography: 25 provinces, 210 districts, 1,661 communes and 14,576 villages with official NCDD codes, Khmer and English names, GeoJSON boundaries and geocoding.

- Base URL: https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me (JSON; GeoJSON for boundary geometry). Only GET.
- No API key. Requests must send a `User-Agent` header, otherwise the API answers 403.
- Admin endpoints take numeric ids (`12`, `1201`, `120101`, `12010101`); boundary endpoints take zero-padded codes (`070203`).
- Rate limits per IP: `/api/admin/*`, `/api/boundaries/*` 10,000 / min; `/api/admin/search` 120 / min; `/api/geocode/*` 30 / min (OpenStreetMap Nominatim fair use); other `/api/*` 5,000 / min.

## Docs

- [Full reference for LLMs](https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me/llms-full.txt): every endpoint with parameters and real example responses, the data model, errors, recipes and gotchas
- [Interactive API docs](https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me/docs): human docs with a live "Send" button for each endpoint
- [API index](https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me/api/info): machine-readable list of endpoints
- [Postman collection](https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me/opengeo-cambodia.postman_collection.json): every request with tests

## Administrative

- [GET /api/admin/provinces](https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me/api/admin/provinces): All 25 provinces and the capital, sorted by code.
- [GET /api/admin/provinces/:id/districts](https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me/api/admin/provinces/12/districts): Districts, khans and krongs belonging to a province.
- [GET /api/admin/districts/:id/communes](https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me/api/admin/districts/1201/communes): Communes and sangkats belonging to a district.
- [GET /api/admin/communes/:id/villages](https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me/api/admin/communes/120101/villages): Villages (phum) belonging to a commune.
- [GET /api/admin/item/:id](https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me/api/admin/item/1201): A single record at any level, looked up by id. Returns 404 if the id does not exist.
- [GET /api/admin/hierarchy/:id](https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me/api/admin/hierarchy/12010101): Returns the place and all its ancestors as an object keyed by level. Use it to render a full address from a single stored id.
- [GET /api/admin/search](https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me/api/admin/search?q=siem%20reap&limit=5): Matches Khmer or English names, ignoring case, spaces and accents. Exact and prefix matches rank first.
- [GET /api/admin/stats](https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me/api/admin/stats): Record counts per level and the last data sync time.

## Boundaries

- [GET /api/boundaries](https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me/api/boundaries?level=district&province_code=12&limit=3): Filter boundaries at any level. Without level it returns provinces. Supports pagination with limit and offset.
- [GET /api/boundaries/provinces](https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me/api/boundaries/provinces?format=summary): All 25 province polygons (about 1 MB as GeoJSON). Use format=summary for centroids and bounding boxes only.
- [GET /api/boundaries/provinces/:code](https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me/api/boundaries/provinces/12): A single province Feature.
- [GET /api/boundaries/districts](https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me/api/boundaries/districts?province_code=12): District polygons, usually filtered by province.
- [GET /api/boundaries/districts/:code](https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me/api/boundaries/districts/1201): A single district Feature.
- [GET /api/boundaries/communes](https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me/api/boundaries/communes?district_code=1201): Commune polygons, filtered by district or province.
- [GET /api/boundaries/communes/:code](https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me/api/boundaries/communes/120101): A single commune Feature.
- [GET /api/boundaries/item/:code](https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me/api/boundaries/item/1201): Detects the level from the code length. Handy when you don't know the level in advance.
- [GET /api/boundaries/:code](https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me/api/boundaries/120101): Shortcut for `/api/boundaries/item/:code`: single boundary lookup by any province, district or commune code (e.g. 12, KH12, 1201, 120101).
- [GET /api/boundaries/hierarchy/:code](https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me/api/boundaries/hierarchy/120101): The Feature for a code plus its parent district and province Features, keyed by level. Returned inside the `{ success, data }` envelope.
- [GET /api/boundaries/stats](https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me/api/boundaries/stats): Polygon counts per level, the national bounding box and the data source.
- [GET /api/boundaries/raw/:filename](https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me/api/boundaries/raw/provinces.geojson): The full source file as an attachment (`Content-Disposition: attachment`). Large download.

## Geocoding

- [GET /api/geocode/reverse](https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me/api/geocode/reverse?lat=11.5564&lon=104.9282): Turn coordinates into an address mapped to Cambodia's hierarchy. Returns 400 for missing/invalid coordinates, 404 if nothing is found, 503 if the upstream service is unavailable.
- [GET /api/geocode/search](https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me/api/geocode/search?q=Angkor%20Wat&limit=3): Find addresses, landmarks and points of interest in Cambodia by name. An empty `q` returns an empty list.

## System

- [GET /](https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me/): Welcome document with links to documentation and key endpoints. Browsers (Accept: text/html) get the web app instead; send `Accept: application/json` or `?json=1` for JSON.
- [GET /health](https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me/health): Liveness probe with uptime.
- [GET /api/info](https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me/api/info): Machine-readable list of every endpoint and the level conventions.
- [GET /llms.txt](https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me/llms.txt): Concise API summary for LLMs (llmstxt.org standard).
- [GET /llms-full.txt](https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me/llms-full.txt): Full API reference for LLMs (llmstxt.org standard).
- [GET /opengeo-cambodia.postman_collection.json](https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me/opengeo-cambodia.postman_collection.json): This Postman collection as JSON. `/postman` redirects here.

## Datasets

- [province.geojson](https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me/api/boundaries/raw/provinces.geojson): 25 province polygons
- [district.geojson](https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me/api/boundaries/raw/districts.geojson): 197 district polygons
- [commune.geojson](https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me/api/boundaries/raw/communes.geojson): 1,633 commune polygons
- [CambodiaGeographicalList.csv](https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me/data/CambodiaGeographicalList.csv): all 16,472 places in one file
- [Per-level CSVs](https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me/data/CambodiaVillagesList.csv): CambodiaProvinceList.csv, CambodiaDistrictList.csv, CambodiaCommuneList.csv, CambodiaVillagesList.csv under /data/

## Optional

- [Source code (GitHub)](https://github.com/pphatdev/opengeo-cambodia): Hono API for Node and Cloudflare Workers, MIT licensed
- [Data source](https://data.mef.gov.kh/): Ministry of Economy and Finance Open Data Portal; boundaries from the Ministry of Land Management, Urban Planning and Construction
